description: Configure SSO/SAML integration for your organization. Actions: set (store IdP config), test (connection test), remove (clear config), claim_domain (issue a DNS TXT verification token), verify_domain (check the TXT record). Requires Enterprise tier (sso_saml feature).

action.description: SSO operation: set, test, remove, claim_domain, or verify_domain

domain.description: Domain to claim, verify, or register (required for set/claim_domain/verify_domain)

idpEntityId.description: IdP entity ID (optional, extracted from metadata)

memberDisposition.description: How to handle existing SSO-provisioned members on remove (default: convert_to_manual)

name: configure_sso
title: Configure SSO
